method.step5: restore the working tree with `git checkout -- <path>` and verify byte-identical restoration before the next family
method.ordering: every family in a proven state (COMPLETE_PACKET_PROVEN, VERIFIED_PASS) first, since those are the ones whose provenance is being relied on
method.note: this tool measures only; it repairs nothing it finds
